description: Historical approved Mozir 8 creative instructions. Adapt to a new apartment; verify current provider schemas. No provider asset IDs or private output paths included.

image_generation.base:
Generate an entirely NEW cinematic architectural photograph from scratch. The attached crude Blender viewport is ONLY a spatial diagram: use the room footprint, openings, approximate furniture locations and view direction. Do NOT edit, beautify, trace or reproduce its pixels, lighting, furniture shapes or plastic surfaces. Rebuild the scene visually as an actual finished, furnished Israeli designer apartment photographed on location. Landscape 16:9, high resolution.
Consistent apartment art direction: contemporary Tel Aviv home, quiet high-end Israeli minimalism, warm off-white lime plaster, pale matte limestone-look porcelain flooring, smoked honey-oak joinery, ivory relaxed linen, muted olive textiles, brushed nickel fixtures with restrained aged-brass lamps, authentic artisan ceramics. Sophisticated slender furniture construction, believable seams, subtle irregular wood grain and stone pores, naturally creased textiles. Restrained actual-home styling, not a showroom full of ornaments. Do not copy the blocky chairs, generic lamps or thick upholstery of the 3D guide.
Cinematography: an architectural cinematographer's frame from a live-action film, natural spatial depth, realistic lens perspective with straight verticals, subtle foreground layering without blocking the room. Late-afternoon Mediterranean sunlight from physically plausible windows, one motivated directional source, soft sky fill, gentle cooler shadows and warm highlights. Exposure protects bright windows but allows shadowed corners to remain darker; no flat ambient wash, no glowing white walls, no excessive orange grading, no fake cinematic haze. Tactile microcontrast, subtle photographic grain, no aggressive HDR, no oversharpening, no dollhouse/CGI surface appearance. Empty room, no people, no text, watermark or collage.
scenes: ONE single wide hero photograph from the entrance side into the spacious living/dining room and terrace, matching the diagram's room layout. Show air and usable floor area. Linen sofa in middle facing a slim oak media console on right; slim curved oak dining chairs with woven seats and an oval oak dining table behind/left, sculptural thin brass pendant; elegant olive chair at right. Use an oval honed travertine coffee table, loosely draped linen throw and a few books. Kitchen edge may enter at far left as foreground. ALL terrace sliding-door glass leaves are stacked at the far right jamb, fully OPEN, with no glass or mullion across the broad central passage. Keep a clear walkable path onto terrace. Outside is a ground-level garden terrace with a rectangular teak table and light rope chairs, olive trees and planted boundary; behind it visible contemporary Israeli midrise cream-stone apartment buildings with recessed balconies and trees. Realistic illustrative neighborhood, not a high-rise rooftop view. Broad 22mm full-frame framing, camera around eye level, composed rather than distorted. Strong afternoon side light rakes across linen and stone, with cool open-sky fill. This ONE image will guide the entire continuous living-to-terrace shot.

Wide master bedroom seen from its doorway, preserve two window positions and bed placement in spatial guide. Real low upholstered king bed with softly winged ivory linen headboard, crisp but naturally rumpled cream duvet, olive cushion and tobacco throw. Slim oak bedside tables, small warm reading lamps, floor-length light linen curtains. Keep room generous and navigable, minimal personal objects. 24mm architectural cinema lens, near doorjamb in a thin foreground strip, warm lateral sun on bedding, soft realistic shadows. Same ground-level Israeli neighborhood beyond windows.

Compact ensuite bathroom photographed from the entrance with vanity, stone basin, rounded mirror and adjacent glass shower visible in a cohesive intimate frame. Preserve the diagram's layout, remodel the crude fixture shapes as real designer sanitaryware. Thin floating smoked-oak vanity, warm matte limestone surfaces, restrained brushed-nickel faucet, frameless optically clear shower screen, linen towel, one handmade soap dish. Do not enlarge this compact ensuite or turn it into the larger bathtub bathroom. 24mm equivalent composition where feasible, realistic broad indirect daylight and one subdued concealed practical, gentle shadow falloff, natural mineral variation.

An editorial room portrait of the small bedroom, NOT a moving doorway view: single upholstered linen bed on left, slim oak writing desk with a real curved timber/woven chair on right, window at back. Preserve compact scale and openings; no added rooms. Warm-white linen duvet and olive cotton throw, subtle wall art, one book and reading lamp. A thoughtful 28mm frame with a near bed edge creating depth, sun softly grazing wrinkled linen and desk. Real inhabited-but-tidy Israeli apartment, no excessive props.

The larger FAMILY BATHROOM, distinct from ensuite. Preserve actual compact rectangular room and fixtures: built-in white bathtub along right wall, floating oak vanity and mirror on left, toilet at far left/back, washing machine at far right/back as shown in guide. All these facilities should be legible. Use a small clear frameless bath splash panel instead of the enormous dark placeholder frame, keep bath unobstructed. Wide architectural camera from entrance, approximately 18mm with corrected verticals, slightly elevated, showing floor and depth. Luxurious believable creamy limestone tile, oak, brushed nickel, a neatly folded cotton towel. Cinematic soft doorway daylight plus discreet warm practical illumination, physically plausible with no invented giant window. Stylish and real, not sterile, not an oversized spa.

A close-wide cinematic portrait of this U-shaped kitchen with cooking peninsula in foreground, sink in back counter and integrated tall refrigerator at left. Preserve exact cabinet/counter arrangement. Warm matte oak lower fronts with refined narrow reveals, subdued pale-sage upper cupboards, honed warm-white quartz counter, real thin black induction hob, brushed-nickel tap. A tactile linen towel, handmade ceramic bowl with three lemons and a small herb pot; no excessive decoration. Low-ish 28mm view across foreground stone corner into kitchen, subtle depth but enough focus to see kitchen facilities. Late-afternoon light reflected from living-room terrace makes a directional pool on oak and counter; discreet warm undercabinet light. Real cabinetry construction, imperfectly natural materials.

A true vertical top-down complete roof-off architectural photograph-style composite of this exact entire apartment AND its full L-shaped wraparound terrace/garden. Preserve every room, partition, fixture and garden extent from guide. Center the full property tightly and evenly with modest margins; don't crop terrace or leave excessive blank space left. Furnish every visible room with the same refined real materials and furniture described above, tiny but detailed true-to-life linens, grain, tiles, plants. The living terrace slider is fully open, clear central passage. Ground-level terrace with real rectangular teak table, rope chairs, olive trees, mixed planting, natural lawn and stepping stones. The impossible roof-off viewpoint is intentional, but MATERIALS AND LIGHT must look photographic, not like a CAD model, plastic miniature or untextured Blender screenshot. Soft directional afternoon sunlight with consistent physical shadows, wall thickness and realistic occlusion. No schematic outlines, no gray proxy surfaces, no room labels.
image_generation.ensuite_correction:
Generate an entirely NEW high-resolution landscape 16:9 cinematic interior photograph from scratch. Attached Blender image is a spatial guide ONLY for the compact ensuite layout and viewing angle, not an image to retouch. Do not use any previous AI image.
A real high-end contemporary Israeli ensuite bathroom viewed from its doorway: small floating smoked honey-oak vanity at center-right, honed warm limestone basin, fine brushed-nickel tap, rounded rectangular mirror, adjacent clear-glass shower on the left. Preserve compact room scale and these fixture positions. Shower is an INDOOR FULLY ENCLOSED WET ROOM backed by solid floor-to-ceiling creamy stone tiled walls. Through the clear glass you see only the solid tiled shower walls, a brushed-nickel shower head and controls, the stone shower floor and a small shampoo niche. The left edge of the shower also ends in a solid tiled wall.
CRITICAL: absolutely no plants, leaves, flowers, trees, vines or greenery anywhere in this bathroom, through glass, or in mirror reflections. No shower window, garden opening, outdoor view, foliage shadow, or outdoor shower. No decorative plant on vanity either. Mirror reflects an interior door and tiled wall only.
Quiet luxury materials: subtly varied matte stone, real oak grain, linen hand towel on right, one soap dish and unlabelled amber bottle, restrained realistic detailing. Delicate bathroom lighting from warm recessed ceiling fixtures and a softly illuminated mirror, with subtle indirect daylight spilling through the doorway BEHIND camera, never through invented windows. Cinematic motivated lighting, natural shadow depth, neutral cream stone with restrained warm highlights, no orange wash or flat HDR. Real architectural photography with tactile microdetail, believable clear glass reflections, straight verticals and wide 24mm perspective. No plastic CGI, no oversized luxurious spa, no text, no logos, no people.
image_generation.terrace_still:
Generate a completely NEW high-resolution 16:9 cinematic architectural photograph from scratch: the final frame after walking out of the living room and turning left to reveal this apartment's terrace/garden.
Reference 1 is a crude Blender spatial guide for the final camera position, direction and garden footprint ONLY. Reference 2 is the approved living-room photograph, provided ONLY for continuity of the exterior dining furniture, planting, cream-stone Israeli neighborhood and afternoon lighting. Do not edit either input image. Create a new outdoor photograph from this new viewpoint.
Camera is standing just outside the wide OPEN sliding doors, at eye level, looking along the full length of the terrace and garden. Very little interior visible: only a narrow apartment facade/doorjamb strip on the far left. Broad 21mm architectural cinema view with corrected verticals, no fisheye. Show the expanse of pale limestone terrace paving in foreground, a rectangular teak outdoor dining table with elegant slender woven-rope chairs to the right foreground (NOT the round placeholder table), the long natural lawn and generous stepping-stone path receding along the house toward the far garden return. Entire visible garden depth and full width are readable; don't fill frame with a close-up table. Olive trees, rosemary and restrained Mediterranean planting along low boundary walls. Ground-floor private garden, not a high-rise balcony. Beyond the perimeter, a beautiful realistic modern Israeli neighborhood with cream limestone midrise residences, recessed balconies, pale plaster and mature trees. Match the character and sun direction of the approved living image.
Designer real-home photography, tactile pale stone with slight weathering, naturally irregular lawn and olive leaves, real timber and woven chair construction. Elegant but subtly lived-in. Strong late-afternoon side/back light, sunlit olive foliage, long soft dappled shadows, warmer highlights balanced with cooler sky fill, believable exposure, restrained photographic grain. No uniformly bright CGI lighting, plastic furniture, over-sharpened grass, glowing white surfaces or fake haze. Keep all terrace doors fully open and the walking passage clear. No people, no text, no logos, no collage. This is a single wide final terrace reveal with an inviting sense of space.
image_generation.notes: Fresh generation, not repeated editing. Terrace still can use living image for continuity but was excluded from the final living video.

living_approved.prompt:
One continuous 8-second live-action architectural camera take in this specific modern Israeli designer apartment. @living is the ONLY photographic reference for the entire shot, indoors AND outdoors. Construct one fixed coherent scene from that image. Keep the same furniture, garden, buildings, sun direction, sky, time of day, white balance and color grading throughout. The exterior already visible through its open doors is the actual exterior to reveal as the camera approaches; extend that SAME space naturally into areas initially offscreen. Do not transition to a second scene or invent a different garden vista.
@motion is the exact approved eight-second camera-motion and spatial guide. Match its camera position, viewing direction and slow timing throughout the entire clip. Use the guide ONLY for architecture and camera, not its crude CGI furniture, colors or lighting. Begin wide at the entrance, walk slowly through the living room, gently turn left to review the living space while continuing to move, then continue at the guide's oblique angle toward the open terrace. End EXACTLY at the guide's final viewpoint. The guide is already slowed and cropped to the approved endpoint: do not complete a longer terrace walk or add a terrace pan, orbit, forward drift or any camera movement beyond that endpoint. Preserve the guide's leisurely pace and complete leftward living-room review. No acceleration to rush outside. No invented camera moves.
All terrace glass leaves stay parked at the right jamb from the first frame. Clear walkable passage, no camera passing through glass, furniture or walls. Living-room sofa, slim oak dining chairs, pendant, olive accent chair and coffee table remain exactly the same objects in stable positions as in @living. Garden furniture, planting and cream-stone Israeli neighborhood must remain consistent with what is already visible in that SAME image from the first frame. Ground-floor private terrace, no elevated balcony.
Film a real scene with a single camera and stable exposure: no sunlight switching sides, new sun flare, time-of-day change, brightness jump, lighting dissolve, scene blend, sky replacement, color-temperature transition or hidden stitch at the doors. Protect outdoor highlight detail from the opening frame so no exposure reset is needed outside. Warm directional afternoon light and believable cooler shadow fill, tactile linen, limestone, wood and foliage, photographic detail and restrained grain.
Absolutely no cuts, dissolves, crossfades, reference-image morphs, furniture redesign, moving architecture, phantom columns, people, captions, logos or narration. Quiet natural room tone and gentle garden ambience only; no music.

reference_roles.living: Single authoritative living photograph, including visible exterior

suite.prompt:
Photographic live-action architectural film of the approved high-end modern Israeli apartment. Match the supplied photographs' real designer furniture, warm limestone, oak, linen and motivated afternoon lighting. Natural contrast and tactile material detail, no plastic CGI or overprocessed HDR. The Blender driver controls ONLY camera trajectory, room geometry and timing: never reproduce its furniture shapes, crude materials or lighting. Architecture and furniture remain fixed in world space while camera moves. No morphing, melting, flicker, hidden jump cuts, dissolves, image crossfades, camera teleportation, people, captions, logos or narration. Restrained natural ambience only, no music.
ONE UNINTERRUPTED 6-SECOND TAKE. @motion is the master-bedroom-to-ensuite camera guide. @bedroom defines the main bedroom's photographic look and @ensuite defines the small adjoining bathroom. Begin at bedroom doorway, enter and establish the bed, linen, side tables and both windows, then make the smooth left turn through the actual ensuite doorway exactly as the motion guide shows. Settle on the floating oak vanity, limestone basin, rounded mirror and enclosed glass shower. Use foreground doorjamb for a real spatial reveal, never dissolve bedroom into bathroom. Bathroom is indoors with SOLID tiled shower walls. No plants, leaves, outdoor view, shower window or greenery visible through glass or in mirrors. Camera remains coherent at human eye level, no sideways jump or impossible wall passage. Match new photographic references, not previous footage.

facilities.prompt:
Photographic live-action architectural film of the approved high-end modern Israeli apartment. Match the supplied photographs' real designer furniture, warm limestone, oak, linen and motivated afternoon lighting. Natural contrast and tactile material detail, no plastic CGI or overprocessed HDR. The Blender driver controls ONLY camera trajectory, room geometry and timing: never reproduce its furniture shapes, crude materials or lighting. Architecture and furniture remain fixed in world space while camera moves. No morphing, melting, flicker, hidden jump cuts, dissolves, image crossfades, camera teleportation, people, captions, logos or narration. Restrained natural ambience only, no music.
EXACTLY THREE DISTINCT SHOTS IN THIS SIX-SECOND CLIP, with crisp hard cuts at 2.0 and 4.0 seconds. @motion is the approved three-shot guide, slowed evenly to six seconds. Each image applies ONLY to its corresponding shot:
0.0–2.0 seconds: @small_bedroom — composed small-bedroom portrait of the linen single bed, oak desk and curved woven chair, with only a subtle 8cm camera drift. Do not walk into the room.
2.0–4.0 seconds: @large_bathroom — wider family bathroom, built-in bathtub on right, vanity on left, toilet at back and washing machine at back right. Follow the driver's shallow backward/sideward move and gentle pan to reveal room depth and all fixtures. The clear splash panel must stay clear and frameless. No invented window, no outside view in shower.
4.0–6.0 seconds: @kitchen — low-ish wide composition across the stone cooking peninsula with thin induction hob in foreground, sage cupboards, oak fronts, sink and integrated refrigerator. Very subtle lateral drift, intentional foreground parallax.
Preserve each room's layout and furniture. No intermediate rooms, extra cuts, blended room transitions or closeup inserts. Hold each composition long enough to read. Same photographic color balance across cuts.

video_generation.notes: The earlier living prompt with a terrace endpoint reference is intentionally omitted because it produced lighting/view discontinuity. The final overhead was animated from an approved still.

music_generation.prompt: Instrumental contemporary jazz fusion, warm, joyful, optimistic and effortlessly stylish, for a cinematic tour of a sunlit designer apartment in Tel Aviv. A real small band with a buoyant laid-back pocket at 104 BPM in 4/4. Lush Rhodes electric piano plays syncopated major-9 and major-13 chord voicings and a catchy short melodic hook; round expressive electric bass answers the melody with tasteful syncopation; clean hollow-body electric guitar adds sparse silky phrases. Tight acoustic drums with delicate hi-hat, ghost-note snare, soft kick and a little shaker. Subtle jazz-funk and Mediterranean warmth, sophisticated yet immediately accessible, bright and inviting. Human touch, organic dynamic playing, polished intimate stereo recording. Begin on the groove with the hook immediately, no long intro. Light harmonic lift around 8 seconds, playful guitar-and-Rhodes exchange around 13 seconds, a warm resolved major chord around 19 seconds, then let it breathe. Keep the arrangement spacious enough for an architectural film. Strictly instrumental: no singing, humming, spoken words or vocal samples. No busy virtuoso solos, frantic bebop, lounge elevator music, cheesy smooth-jazz saxophone, dramatic cinematic pads or heavy rock distortion. Maintain a happy confident feel throughout.
